def walk(n):
    if n.type in ('call_expression','method_call_expression') and n.start_point.row<=586<=n.end_point.row:
        print(n.type, n.start_point.row+1, src[n.start_byte:n.end_byte].decode())
        print([(c.type, src[c.start_byte:c.end_byte].decode()) for c in n.children])
    for c in n.children: walk(c)
walk(tree.root_node)
